result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for people walking. However, the wide roadway and large turning radii increase pedestrian exposure and allow for higher vehicle speeds during turns.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing their time in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center crosswalk where the pedestrian is currently walking.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry near the gas station is wide, which encourages higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner adjacent to the Conoco gas station.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. A large bus is currently stopped near the crossing, creating a significant visual obstruction for both pedestrians and oncoming motorists.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from bus
hazards.description: A large bus is stopped at or near the crosswalk, blocking the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching from the rear of the bus.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: The crossing lacks stop signs or signals for the main roadway, requiring pedestrians to find gaps in potentially fast-moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the travel lane.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs, potentially with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs), to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps. A traffic signal is present, but a large portion of the view is obscured by blurring, and no dedicated pedestrian signals are visible.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction (Parked Vehicle)
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked close to the crosswalk, potentially obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present, no dedicated pedestrian signals are visible to guide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals, but is characterized by a car-centric design with wide curb radii and multiple commercial driveways. Pedestrians are exposed to potential conflicts with vehicles entering and exiting parking lots across the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The large turning radius at the corner allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple access points for the commercial property create frequent conflict zones where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on the right side of the image.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to narrow the roadway at the crossing, reducing pedestrian exposure and slowing turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals to provide clear timing information for those crossing the street.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number of curb cuts to minimize the number of points where vehicles and pedestrians interact.
